# GraphQL Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > GraphQL

## Overview

Tests GraphQL APIs with proper query testing, mutation testing, subscription testing, and schema validation approaches

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [graphql-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
graphql-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@graphql-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Test queries with proper assertion patterns
- Test mutations with input validation
- Test subscriptions with mock pub/sub
- Validate schema with breaking change detection

## Technology Standards Applied

- **GraphQL Testing**: Query and mutation test patterns
- **Schema Validation**: Schema linting and change detection
- **Integration Testing**: End-to-end GraphQL API testing
